snippet.description:
Most career advice comes from an economy that no longer exists. So how do you make smart decisions about work when the rules keep changing? That’s where economic commentator and New York Times best-selling author Kyla Scanlon comes in. Each week on Best of Luck, she talks with economists, journalists, farmers, comedians and more to help us all make sense of the economy, and figure out how to make work work.

New episodes every Tuesday, starting October 27, 2026. 

Follow the podcast on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bestofluckpodcast
Follow Kyla Scanlon: https://www.instagram.com/kylascan/

Vox.com is a news website that helps you cut through the noise and understand what's really driving the events in the headlines. Check out http://www.vox.com.

snippet.description:
Preparing for UPSC CSE 2027 or 2028 and confused about whether to study Geography from NCERTs, GC Leong, or both? These two webinars by LevelUp IAS are designed to help UPSC beginners build a clear and practical Geography preparation strategy.

🔗 Register for the Free Geography Webinars:
https://www.levelupias.com/lp/upsc-cse-strategy-sessions/

📚 Webinar 1: Geography Preparation Strategy
Understand how to approach Geography for UPSC and manage your study resources effectively. Learn how to resolve the NCERT vs GC Leong dilemma and build a structured preparation plan.

🗺️ Webinar 2: Geography Answer Writing, Mapping & Current Affairs
Learn how to approach Geography answer writing, prepare mapping topics, and integrate current affairs into your UPSC Geography preparation.

📅 Webinar Dates: 24 October and 25 October 2026

🎯 Who Should Attend?
UPSC beginners, especially aspirants targeting UPSC CSE 2027 and 2028, who want clarity on Geography resources, preparation strategy, answer writing, and mapping.

Don't let confusion over books and resources delay your preparation. Join these sessions and take the first step towards a more structured UPSC Geography strategy.

#UPSC2028 #UPSC2027 #UPSCGeography #GeographyForUPSC #UPSCPreparation #NCERT #GCLeong #UPSCPrelims #UPSCMains #LevelUpIAS
